sentences.text: This first application under section 438 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for grant of anticipatory bail.
Applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with crime No. 79/2024 registered at police station Vijay Nagar, Indore for the offence under section 420 IPC 2.

As per prosecution story, report was lodged by the complainant that his son Arpit Parmar had booked tour package for Thailand for 4 persons and Maldives for 2 persons for which the complainant had contacted the authorised employee/co-accused Anand Gour and Sanju Chourasiya.

For the Thiland and Signing time: 2/16/2024 2:49:12 Maldives Tour, the complainant paid Rs.2,55,182/- and Rs.2,30,200/- (total Rs.4,85,382/-) and the present applicant assured the complainant on telephone that in case of tour cancellation the complete deposited amount will be refunded back to the complainant on which complainant's son Arpit Parmar, paid the aforesaid Hariom Jhunjhunwala vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6513147/
1 amount to the accused persons but the accused persons did not furnish any information regarding the programme and Air Tickets, due to which the complainant had to cancel the tour and authorised employee, Anand Gour assured to refund the deposited amount but few days after the mobile number of co-accused Anand Gour was switched off and when contacted the present applicant refused to refund the mount.

sentences.text: On these sets of allegations, an FIR pertaining to the aforesaid case has been registered at P.S. Vijay Nagar against the present applicant and co-accused Anand Gour and Sanju Choursiya.

3. Counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is Proprietor of Rashi Travels and in the account of the firm only an amount of Rs.49,333/- has been deposited as initial booking amount on 6.09.2023.
The other amount has been deposited in the account of Anand Gour and Sanju Choursiya.
4. Counsel for the State and the complainant opposed the prayer and submitted that it is not disputed that co-accused Anand Gour and Sanju Chourasiya are employees of the applicant.

According to the complainant, he had deposited Rs.2,55,182/- and Rs.2,30,200/- (total Rs.4,85,382/-).
5.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration that the applicant is Proprietor of the firm and it is not in dispute that in the account of the firm, Rs.49,333/- was deposited as initial booking amount on 6.9.2023, the other amount has been deposited in the account of co- accused Anand Gour and Sanju Chourasiya who alleged to have committed Signing time: 2/16/2024 2:49:12 cheating, this Court is of the view that prima facie case is made out for grant of anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the M.Cr.C. is allowed and it is directed that if the applicant furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Investigating Officer, then he shall be released by the Investigating Officer.

The applicant shall also comply with the following conditions :-
(i) that the applicant shall refund a sum of Rs.49,333/- in the account of the complainant.
The complainant shall furnish the account details to the applicant.
(ii) the applicant shall produce copy of the statement of accounts to show that aforesaid amount has been transferred in the account of the complainant.
(iii) only on filing of such receipt/statement of account, the applicant shall be released by the Investing Officer.
6. The applicant shall also give an undertaking that he would appear before the Court as and when directed.
This order shall remain in force till conclusion of trial.
C.c. as per rules.
(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE MK Signing time: 2/16/2024 2:49:12
